h1: Gabon tourist visa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Gabon? This page explains the Gabon tourist visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay
documents: Passport photo page scan, valid for at least 6 months
Hotel booking, or an invitation from the people you’re visiting

sections.heading: Do you need a Gabon tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Gabon, and can apply online for an eVisa before travelling. The approval is then presented on arrival.

sections.heading: What a Gabon tourist visa covers
sections.text: A Gabon tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Gabon. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Gabon business visa](/gabon-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way.

sections.heading: Gabon tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Gabon tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Gabon.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Gabon tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Gabon tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Gabon on a Gabon tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Gabon tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
